gap_details.2012-2013: No Wayback capture of CurrentResidents between 2011-12-17 and 2014-02-17. Observed via Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2013-20 (2013-05-24): full 14-name list, Craig/Yang PGY I. Loaded as source_type other.
gap_details.2013-2014: Page (Wayback 2014-02-17; CC 2014-03..2014-08) only linked 'Neurosurgery Residents (Academic Year 2013-2014) (3).pdf'; the PDF has no Wayback or CC capture and is 404 live. Reconstructed 12: 9 bracketed by 2012-13 and 2014-15, Shafer (alumni 2007-14), Folzenlogen and Kunigelis (interns; alumni 2013-2020). Arianne Boylan not reconstructed (never seen after 2012-13). SIGNIFICANT: a 2013 intern who left in their first year would be invisible. PHASE 2: gapaudit (Neurosurgery, SOM education, surgery, gme hosts 2013-06..2014-10): only the PDF link, per-resident pages start Dec 2015; Documents/ folders hold no roster (Feb 2014 conference schedule names only Leslie Robinson). CC-MAIN-2014-41 retried OK (no roster). PubMed affiliation mining 2013-15 found no unknown residents. Boylan confirmed as transfer to Wayne State (program 125: Year 5 2014-15, alumni 2017).
gap_details.2016-2017: Only capture with 2016-17 content is spring (2017-03-24); July 2016 capture still showed 2015-16. Full list, no gap.
gap_details.2019-2020: ucdenver page frozen with 2018-19 content (identical digest Aug 2018..Oct 2019); cuanschutz roster page first archived 2020-10-28; CC 2019-2020 cuanschutz crawls had only the residency-program intro and alumni pages. Reconstructed 12: 9 bracketed by 2018-19 and 2020-21 plus Folzenlogen/Kunigelis/Yang (PGY6 2018-19, alumni grad 2020). NOT reconstructed: 2019 interns Lindsey Freeman and Ashkaun Razmara (first seen 2020-21 PGY II) and William McKay (first seen 2020-21 PGY IV). SIGNIFICANT. PHASE 2: added L. Freeman and Razmara as reconstructed PGY1 (PGY II 2020-21). McKay joined July 2020 from UNM (program 97 phase 2: UNM accreditation withdrawn 2020-06-30), so he is correctly absent. CC-MAIN-2019-09 and 2019-51 retried OK: 2019-51 shows ucdenver CurrentResidents 302-redirecting; no roster. Per-resident ucdenver pages (Chatain, Hoffman, Wittenberg 2019-07; Hosein 2019-11) are stale bios. PubMed affiliation mining 2019-20 found no unknown residents.
gap_details.2021-2022: cuanschutz page kept its '20-21 PGY' content through 2021-12-08 (Wayback + CC 2021-04..2021-49); next change 2022-08-15. CC-MAIN-2022-27 retried: no roster URL. Reconstructed 12 bracketed by 2020-21 and 2022-23. NOT reconstructed: 2021 interns Reinier Alvarez and William Harris (first seen 2022-23 PGY II). SIGNIFICANT: a 2021 intern who left in PGY1 would be invisible. PHASE 2: department newsletter Spring 2021 (https://medschool.cuanschutz.edu/docs/librariesprovider62/newsletters/internal-final-headlines_newsletter_spring21-.pdf) lists 'New Interns' Reinier Alvarez (FIU) and William Harris (U Hawaii) only, and graduating chiefs Whelan and Hosein; added Alvarez/Harris as reconstructed PGY1. Fall 2021 and Winter 2021 newsletters name no resident changes (Razmara Resident of the Quarter). PubMed 2021-23 affiliation mining found no unknown residents.
gap_details.2022-2023: Primary capture 2022-08-15. A 2023-03-29 capture (loaded as 'other') shows a mid-year change: Andrew Donovan (PGY III) removed, Ahmed Helal added at PGY II.
gap_details.2023-2024: Dec 2023 capture heading reads 'Neurosurgery Residents 2022-23' but the content is 2023-24 (Chatain/McKay PGY VII, new interns Butterfield/Montgomery/Svalina). The heading lags a year on later versions too.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page heading still says '2025-26' but PGYs are advanced and the 2026 Match interns (Sidi Mohamed, Wu, Patel; confirmed by the 2026-03-23 Match Day news post) are PGY I, so it is loaded as 2026-27.
